about.title: About us
about.missionBody: Bionexo is an online store dedicated to connecting those who generate recovered materials and eco-friendly products with those who want to consume more consciously. We believe one person's waste can be another's raw material.
about.umbrellaBody: Bionexo is backed by Tu Basura Innova, a global circular economy brand that supports projects like this one so more waste becomes opportunity.
about.historyBody: Instead of extract, produce, use and discard, the circular economy proposes recover, reuse and regenerate. Every product you see on Bionexo helps keep something out of a landfill a little longer.
